title: Author directive: 2027 League of Legends Tier 2 regional ecosystems
locator: Author-confirmed canon directive, 2027 League Tier 2 ecosystems batch
publicLabel: Kairos Universe canon directive: 2027 League Tier 2 regional ecosystems
notes: This is a direct author-confirmed canon directive, not sourced from episode prose: no episode depicts a Tier 2 ecosystem announcement.
Recorded as a clearly labeled author-directive source record per the author's own instruction.

Establishes four Kairos Universe fictional 2027 Tier 2 regional ecosystems: EMEA Masters (Europe), LCK Challengers (Korea), LCP Challengers (Pacific), and Circuito Desafiante (Brazil), each with 8 teams, confirmed by the author to name the eight participating organizations only.
Every team named by this directive is explicitly fictional speculation for the Kairos Universe continuity. It is not a report of any real organization's actual current competitive status.
Establishes no standings, placements, series/game records, prize distributions, or promotion/relegation results. All 2027 Tier 2 results begin unconfirmed.
Establishes no automatic Tier 1 promotion and no automatic international qualification (Crossroads Challengers, Rift Masters Challengers, WSCI) for any Tier 2 team.

Where a Tier 2 team's name denotes a known Tier 1 organization's academy/challenger branch (e.g. T1 Esports Academy, paiN Academy, Ground Zero Academy, CFO Academy), a parent-organization relationship to the existing pre-Worlds 2026 reference team is recorded where the author explicitly confirmed it; the two remain separate competitive team entities and are never merged.
